source: WAEC, 2024 and 2025 BECE (School Candidates) Chief Examiners' Reports
note: Findings are summarised in our own words for question design. Do not copy WAEC questions or mark schemes.

Mathematics.format: Paper 2 has six multi-part word and calculation questions, each with parts (a) and (b); marks go for working shown, not only the final answer.
weak: simplifying algebraic expressions (the most serious weakness)
solving algebraic equations and forming an equation from a word problem
expressing a number in standard form and converting decimals to whole numbers
distance-time graphs
listing members of a set with correct curly brackets, including the empty set and the set itself as subsets
using the correct unit, GH¢, and showing evidence of working
Mathematics.tip: In the marking guide show every step of working, write GH¢ for money, and add one 'common mistake' line per theory answer.
weak2024: probability with two events, such as listing the outcomes of a die and a coin
reading and using a scale
enlargement of a shape
geometric constructions
giving the correct unit in the final answer
repeated: showing evidence of working and using the right unit, GH¢ for money

Integrated Science.format: Paper 2 is four structured questions chosen from a set, usually built on a figure or diagram, with practical and calculation parts.
weak: explaining processes and phenomena in full sentences
applying a concept to a new situation
practical aspects of an experiment (apparatus, method, observation, precaution)
mathematical problems such as work, input, output and efficiency
spelling scientific names and terms correctly
Integrated Science.tip: Include at least one 'explain' and one 'apply' part, a figure described in words, and a note to spell key terms correctly. Remind learners to give each question about the same time.
weak2024: spelling key scientific terms correctly
expressing answers in good English
practical questions and experiments
understanding what command words such as explain, state and what is demand
covering the whole syllabus, including fundamental and derived quantities and SI units
repeated: understanding command words such as explain and state

English Language.format: Paper 2 has an essay part (a formal or informal letter, article or speech of about 250 words), a reading comprehension part and a literature part.
weak: writing a full-length essay of about 250 words
paragraphing with unity and order
grammar, punctuation and spelling
working out the meaning of words in context
spelling literary devices correctly
using formal letter features and register
strong: features of formal and informal letters
English Language.tip: Ask for answers in the candidate's own words, never copied from the passage, and name the features examiners mark.
weak2024: grammar, punctuation and spelling
explaining expressions in the reading passage
spelling literary devices and character names
copying parts of the passage instead of answering what was asked
knowing the set literature text
repeated: explaining the meaning of words and expressions in context

Social Studies.format: Paper 2 has structured essay-type questions that ask for reasons, contributions and explanations.
weak: contributions of the 1992 Constitution to national development
why Ghana became a republic
why society should be educated on human rights
why an individual should join a social security scheme
Social Studies.tip: Include 'give reasons' and 'explain the importance of' parts, with a marking guide that lists acceptable points.
weak2024: challenges of using technology and why technology matters in daily life
how national elections promote democracy
workable ways of making water bodies safe

Religious and Moral Education.format: Paper 2 has context-based structured questions across Christianity, Islam and African Traditional Religion.
weak: the importance of sacrifice to a believer
differences between Idul Fitr and Idul Adha
factors that cause bribery and corruption
lessons from religious and non-religious songs
answering context questions
Religious and Moral Education.tip: Include a short context passage and ask learners to draw lessons from it.
weak2024: factors to consider when choosing what to wear to an occasion
why some young people dress inappropriately
how people gain and use authority in society
answering context or scenario questions

Computing.format: Paper 2 mixes concept questions with practical steps in word processing, publishing and spreadsheets.
weak: flowcharts
file compression
making a hyperlink in a word processor and writing text over an image in a publisher
data communication models
number conversion
real-world uses of robotics
Computing.tip: Ask for step-by-step practical procedures and short number-conversion calculations, with working shown.
weak2024: the algorithm concept
reading information from a QR code
features of a desktop publisher and why a file becomes large
practical design of a web blog

Career Technology.format: Paper 2 has compulsory questions and a choice section, with sketches and practical processes.
weak: describing techniques for shaping biscuits
identifying a Warrington hammer and sketching striking tools accurately
answering the compulsory questions as instructed
Career Technology.tip: Ask for labelled sketches and step-by-step practical descriptions, and say which questions are compulsory.
weak2024: finishing the edge of a plain seam
safe substances for preserving fruits, onions and fresh fish
entrepreneurship
arranging the steps for preparing a tenon
sketching a centre punch
repeated: putting practical steps in the right order

Creative Arts and Design.format: Paper 2 has practical drawing, design process and performing arts questions.
weak: drawing an accurate six-point colour wheel and placing primary and secondary colours correctly
hatching and stippling shading
steps in clay preparation
names of lines and spaces on the staff, clefs and note values
the concept of dance drama
strong: choosing a printing technique and giving a reason
Creative Arts and Design.tip: Ask for steps in order and labelled sketches, and describe any drawing in words for the teacher.
weak2024: using the given space and drawing a cone
hatching and stippling shading
the first four steps of the design process
pitches and clefs on the staff
simple time signatures
traditional dances and the ethnic groups they come from
repeated: pitches, clefs and note values on the staff

French.format: Paper 2 has two compulsory questions: a short form to fill in with brief answers, and a letter or essay of about 40 marks needing a greeting, body and closing; also tests comprehension and grammar.
weak: limited vocabulary, with English words used in French essays
faulty constructions, grammar and spelling
punctuation
French.tip: Ask for answers fully in French and include a short vocabulary-building task.
weak2024: English words used in place of French vocabulary
spelling and verb conjugation
organising a letter or essay with a greeting, body and closing
writing the date in words
answering a form in full sentences instead of short answers
repeated: English words used in place of French vocabulary
